description: A faithful Codex pet version of the Mecha Poly Bear: a compact mechanical poly bear with faceted stone-metal planes, round faceted ears, tiny deep-set eyes, thick paws, and signature circular side hatch joints.

idle.notes: Calm guardian baseline with subtle breathing, tiny blink, and planted compact posture.

walk.notes: True directional walk rows used for movement and drag-facing behavior.

curious.notes: Quiet attentive lean with slight head tilt and focused eyes.

happy.notes: Restrained pleased pose with a small head lift and soft paw gesture.

sleep.notes: Prone tucked nap row with closed eyes and minimal sleepy breathing.

loaf.notes: Spare atlas row repurposed as a compact seated loaf rest.

patrol.notes: Spare atlas row repurposed as a slow guarded patrol cycle.

drag.notes: Directional drag intentionally reuses the true left and right walk rows.

sniff.notes: No dedicated spare row remained after prioritizing patrol, jump, and loaf; Brik's curious row carries the nose-forward attentive feel and patrol adds the slow searching motion.

dragFacingValidation.rule: deltaX < 0 => facing left; deltaX > 0 => facing right
manualVerification: walk_left is a true left-facing strip, not an unchecked mirror
walk_right is a true right-facing strip
left drag uses the left-facing walk row
right drag uses the right-facing walk row
left drag never faces right and right drag never faces left
head planes, muzzle, eyes, body direction, side hatch, and paws stay directionally unified in both walk rows

visualIdentityChecklist: low-poly faceted head and cheeks remain readable
round ears remain present and faceted
circular side hatch joints remain visible
thick paws and compact heavy proportions remain readable
stone-brown and old brass palette stays consistent
